card.name: Decimal points in small concentrations
card.fires_on: The decimal point or following zero in a number below one, such as 0.3%, 0.9% or 0.01 mg/mL. It appears in solution strengths and concentrations.

modes.label: Decimal point after 0
modes.description: The point right after a leading zero in a percent or concentration.

modes.label: Zero after the point
modes.description: A zero digit following 0. in a very dilute strength.
